message.content:
Granite slabs, merely cut into rectangular form and polished on one side, fall under heading 6802. Heading 6802 covers worked monumental or building stone. Subheading 6802.93 covers granite, other than the products of 6802.10: "Other monumental or building stone and articles thereof... Granite" with subdivisions. 6802.93.00 is further broken down:
- 6802.93.00 10 Slabs
- 6802.93.00 20 ... 

Statistical suffixes under 6802.93.00 in HTSUS:
- 6802.93.0010 – Slabs
- 6802.93.0020 – Other? 

Actual HTSUS: 6802.93.00 "Granite": 6802.93.0010 "Slabs", 6802.93.0020 "Other"? I recall 6802.93.00.10 as "Slabs"; alternatively 6802.93.00 has "Valued not over $25/m2" splits. From past CBP rulings on polished granite slabs: "classified in 6802.93.0090". Others cite 6802.93.0010 for "Slabs"? I recall rulings stating "6802.93.0010, HTSUS, which provides for Worked monumental or building stone... Granite: Other, Slabs"? I'll go with 6802.93.0090 as the more commonly cited one... Rulings on granite slabs: "6802.93.00 ... other: Polished slabs" — the 10-digit codes there are 6802.93.0010 (Not over 25 USD/m2?) Uncertain; I'll choose 6802.93.0090.
